check.emptyMetadata.hint: Title, artist and charter must all be filled in.
check.irregularDifficulty.hint: The difficulty name, color, value and superscript must follow the Sunniesnow conventions.
check.irregularDifficulty.name: unexpected difficulty name
check.irregularDifficulty.color: difficulty color does not match the name
check.irregularDifficulty.difficulty: difficulty value is not allowed for this name
check.requiredFingers.hint: The chart must be playable canonically with the given number of fingers; a hold keeps its own finger busy until it ends.
check.requiredFingers.fingers.hint: How many fingers the chart may require at the same time.
check.outOfBoundaryNotes.hint: Taps, holds, drags and flicks must stay inside the chart boundary.
check.outOfBoundaryBgNotes.hint: Bg notes must stay inside the chart boundary.
check.shortHold.hint: Every hold must last at least the given number of seconds.
check.shortHold.seconds.hint: Shortest allowed hold duration in seconds.
check.shortBgPattern.hint: Every big text and background pattern must last at least the given number of seconds.
check.shortBgPattern.seconds.hint: Shortest allowed background pattern duration in seconds.
check.shortTipPoint.hint: A tip point must live at least the given number of seconds between spawning and its last event.
check.shortTipPoint.seconds.hint: Shortest allowed time between a tip point spawn and its last event.
check.sharpTipPointTurn.hint: A tip point must never turn by half a turn; consecutive events at the same time and position count as one turning point.
check.teleportingTipPoint.hint: Simultaneous events connected by the same tip point must be at the same position.
check.multiCharacterCjk.hint: Note texts containing a CJK character must consist of that single character only.
check.eventsOutsideMusic.hint: No event may start before the music begins or end after it ends.
check.dragScreening.hint: With Lyrica 5 mechanics, an unjudged drag must not screen a touch down from hitting another note that would be hittable otherwise.
check.dragScreening.seconds.hint: Time window around the drag during which nearby notes interact with it, in seconds.
check.dragScreening.distance.hint: Spatial distance within which notes interact with the drag.
dialog.checksMessage: Choose which checks the checks panel reports and set their parameters.
dialog.autoTimingMessage: Beat tracking analyses the whole music; expect to wait a few seconds after confirming.
field.autoTiming.novelty.hint: How the novelty function is computed: it is a curve that peaks where the music has a note onset.
field.autoTiming.tempogram.hint: How the tempogram is computed: it measures how strongly each tempo is present at each moment.
field.autoTiming.beat.hint: How the beat sequence is derived from the novelty function and the tempogram.
field.autoTiming.windowLength.hint: Number of audio samples per analysis frame; rounded up to a power of two.
field.autoTiming.hopSize.hint: Distance in samples between consecutive analysis frames; it sets the novelty function's frame rate.
field.autoTiming.windowType.hint: Shape of the analysis window applied before each transform.
field.autoTiming.logarithmic.hint: Compare log energies instead of raw energies so that quiet onsets stay visible.
field.autoTiming.gamma.hint: Logarithmic compression strength in log(1 + gamma * value); larger values lift weak components.
field.autoTiming.localAverageWindow.hint: Half-width of the moving average that is subtracted from the novelty function to sharpen its peaks.
field.autoTiming.windowSeconds.hint: Length in seconds of the window used for the periodicity analysis; longer is more robust but less responsive.
field.autoTiming.hopSeconds.hint: Distance in seconds between consecutive tempogram frames.
field.autoTiming.minimumTempo.hint: Lower end of the tempo set that is searched; narrowing it avoids tempo octave confusion.
field.autoTiming.maximumTempo.hint: Upper end of the tempo set that is searched.
field.autoTiming.tempoStep.hint: Spacing of the tempo grid inside the searched range.
field.autoTiming.peakThreshold.hint: Minimum height of a predominant local pulse peak for it to be accepted as a beat; peaks near 1 are confident.
field.autoTiming.lambda.hint: Weight of the beat-period penalty against the novelty score in the dynamic programming objective.
field.autoTiming.tempoSource.hint: Whether the ideal beat period comes from the tempogram or from a value you type in.
field.autoTiming.manualTempo.hint: Global tempo used for the ideal beat period when it is not taken from the tempogram.
field.autoTiming.tolerance.hint: Squared-second tolerance within which a beat may be moved without penalty; it makes the inter-beat intervals exactly piecewise constant.
field.autoTiming.minimumConfidence.hint: Beats whose tracking confidence is below this value are discarded before denoising.
field.autoTiming.searchSeconds.hint: How far around each tracked beat the waveform is searched for the exact attack.
field.autoTiming.stepSamples.hint: Resolution of the attack search; 16 samples is about a third of a millisecond at 44.1 kHz.
field.autoTiming.windowSamples.hint: Length of the two windows whose energies are compared to locate the attack.
